findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed washing hands and turning off the faucet without using a barrier. The employee was educated by the inspector on proper handwashing procedures, and the person-in-charge (PIC) was instructed to review proper handwashing practices with all employees. Ensure a barrier, such as a paper towel, is used to turn off the faucet after handwashing to prevent recontamination of clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The pizza holder machine was observed to have food debris accumulation from the previous day. CORRECTED: The inspector advised the PIC to always clean the pizza holder machine at the end of the day after food operation hours since it is a food contact surface. The machine was cleaned to sight and touch by an employee during the inspection. Ensure food contact surfaces are kept free of food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: A sanitizer bucket was not observed at the facility when the inspector arrived. CORRECTED: The PIC prepared a sanitizer bucket at the start of the inspection. Ensure sanitizer bucket is available and replaced every 2 - 4 hours during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. [P]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There was no certified food protection manager present during today’s inspection. PIC informed inspector upon arrival that they are currently in the process of getting the examination for the certification done. Ensure that there is at least one staff member that is a certified food protection manager in the facility during operational hours at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the area of wall around the mop sink to be in disrepair. The wall was removed during the winter due to an issue where some plumbing froze. Replace the drywall and seal the mop sink to the wall on all sides. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
